mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in FEDFUNDS (current value below 3-month moving average) signals monetary easing, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is not in a downward trend (current value ≥ 3-month MA) or 20-day forward returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in UNRATE (current value below 3-month moving average) indicates improving labor market conditions, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is not in a downward trend (current value ≥ 3-month MA) or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in FEDFUNDS above 2% signals monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not cross above 2% or 20-day returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in UNRATE above 5% reflects weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not cross above 5% or returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1 (demand) signal monetary easing and robust demand, amplifying positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the two proxies do not co-occur or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Higher current supply (INDPRO) than demand (GDPC1) indicates potential oversupply, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO is not greater than GDPC1 or 60-day returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE signals easing monetary policy and improving labor market, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If either proxy does not decline or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rise in FEDFUNDS above 1% signals tightening, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1% in late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, FEDFUNDS does not cross above 1% or 60-day returns are not negative.
